summary.text: The luck path supreme true inheritance is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's luck path legacy sealed as one of the three supreme true inheritances inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building's true inheritance secluded domain.

claims.text: Mo Yao identifies a cracked inheritance in the true inheritance secluded domain as the luck path supreme true inheritance. She had forced a crack in it to obtain Fortune Rivalling Heaven Gu; the Gu flew away, and she settled for refining Calamity Beckoning Gu instead. Because the inheritance is no longer perfect, its balance tilts and true inheritances can collide; a collision can even spill a Gu from it without a full test.
Grade labels for ordinary, unparalleled, and supreme true inheritances are covered on True Inheritance Grades.

A golden light lump crashes like a meteor and shelters Ma Hong Yun and Zhao Lian Yun. Mo Yao names it the luck path supreme true inheritance that should have remained in the true inheritance secluded domain. It recognizes Ma Hong Yun as master of its own accord because he carries the power of Fortune Rivalling Heaven Gu, which is the true essence of Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck path and the emperor of that supreme inheritance.

Every true inheritance in the secluded domain is normally governed by Giant Sun’s will, which is why the luck path supreme true inheritance did not fly to Ma Hong Yun earlier. Within that inheritance there is no Giant Sun’s will: the will retreated, a newborn wild will formed, and that will chose Ma Hong Yun. As a mortal Fang Yuan cannot break the protection. Helping Ma Hong Yun earlier would have placed Fang Yuan inside like Zhao Lian Yun, where the newborn wild will had no internal defenses and would have shown the inheritance’s details.

Giant Sun’s will calls taking back the luck path true inheritance most important after killing the otherworldly demon, and states that this is the only record of that luck path true inheritance left in the entire world; even Longevity Heaven holds no details of it.
Narration repeats that it is the one and only record Giant Sun Immortal Venerable left of this luck path true inheritance, and that destroying it would make it irrecoverable.

Eighty-Eight True Yang Building holds three supreme true inheritances. The first is rank nine Wisdom Gu. The second is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable’s luck path inheritance. The third is Eighty-Eight True Yang Building itself, meaning control of the building.

Holders.text: Ma Hong Yun Zhao Lian Yun

Location.text: Eighty-Eight True Yang Building true inheritance secluded domain
